title: Core: AS2 ternary operator and comma operator
description: Verify AS2 ternary and comma operators compile: x ? a : b, (a, b, c) (comma expression). Also verify compound assignment operators: +=, -=, *=, /=, %=, &=, |=, ^=, <<=, >>=, >>>=. Tests in packages/core/src/as2/__tests__/operators.test.ts.
